reproduction.method: Freeze train simulation and follow camera after loading terrain; alternate the world origin by 512 m on X/Z; capture the first four rendered frames after each shift.
reproduction.before: The entire instanced train disappears on the first rendered frame after the shift and returns on the second. Track, scenery and UI remain visible.

cause: MultiMesh geometry moved inside its instance buffer during floating-origin rebases while automatic culling bounds lagged behind. Both camera rendering and shadow rendering depend on these bounds.
fix: Anchor each batch node to its absolute 512 m world cell; store per-instance transforms relative to that cell.
On rebase, move the batch node without teleporting geometry inside its buffer.
Publish tight explicit MultiMesh bounds from current transformed template bounds on every sync, including new or resized batches.
Cache template bounds and local batch origins; only update native node positions when their origin changes.

limits: This isolates origin-shift rendering rather than measuring moving-camera frame times. Shadow rendering stays enabled with the existing 1 km limit; culling remains enabled.
